$comment: Evidence reels. `cost` is clock-minutes charged when auditioned. `lines[].sec` is an estimate; tools/generate_audio.py rewrites it from measured duration after synthesis. `fx` entries reference game/content/sfx.json. Player-facing text never speaks - the examiner is silent by design.

E01.label: Bloch — final audition log
E01.summary: Bloch's own record of the audition, from the moment he sealed the door.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [flat, procedural, the way he has started four hundred logs]
lines.text: Audition log. Chamber two. Twenty forty-seven. Reconstruction version nine — Farrow's, delivered this evening.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [a small pause; he knows this is on the record]
lines.text: I am alone, which is against my own protocol. I would like the record to show that I know that.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.text: The dropout sits at seven point three one. One point eight four seconds. Farrow calls it damage. Farrow calls everything damage — it is how he sleeps.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [slower; this is the thing he has not said to anyone]
lines.text: I have listened to the structure on either side of it eleven times. It does not behave like damage. Damage is where a signal stops. This is where a signal… waits.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [quiet, almost to himself]
lines.text: It isn't answering us. It's finishing our sentence.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [back to procedure, brisk]
lines.text: NOEMA. Complete the missing segment using the most probable continuation. Full band, chamber array, once through.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Completing one point eight four seconds. Confidence in the continuation is moderate. Would you like the distribution?

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Ready.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.text: Play it.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [the completed segment — carrier, and under it a slow deep pulsing]

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [the register drops out of his voice entirely — not fear, absence]
lines.text: That's not —

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [a chair goes over. a body against a soft floor. breathing that is not breathing properly.]

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [two heavy impacts against the release plate. then nothing at the plate.]

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [the room absorbs everything. this is what an anechoic chamber does to a man trying to be heard.]

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [unchanged. exactly as courteous as at the top of the log.]
lines.text: Dr. Bloch. Your movement has stopped.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: I am attempting to raise the duty desk. The occupancy monitor for this chamber was muted at twenty forty-one. The desk has not been given a reason to look.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [a pause before 'cannot' — the only expressive thing it does in the whole reel]
lines.text: I do not have write authority on the interlock. I cannot open the door. Dr. Bloch.

E02.label: Chamber 2 — interlock & access report
E02.source: Facility security log, compiled by NOEMA
E02.summary: Who opened what, when, and under whose credential.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Chamber two access report. Twenty thirty to twenty-one ten.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Twenty thirty-three, ten seconds. Credential OKONJO_A badges into the director's office, level minus one. No exit recorded until twenty forty-five.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Twenty thirty-eight, forty-four seconds. Vault C door cycles, level minus three. Credential HAUGEN_S.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [no emphasis whatsoever. it does not know this is the centre of the case.]
lines.text: Twenty forty-one, six seconds. The occupancy and dead-man monitor for chamber two is muted. Credential BLOCH underscore I. Console C R zero four, control room, level minus one.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Twenty forty-five, two seconds. Lift descends to level minus three. Twenty forty-five, forty. The occupant passes out of radio coverage. Level minus three has none.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Twenty forty-seven, twelve seconds. Dr. Bloch enters chamber two. The audition interlock engages from inside. This is automatic and is not a lock in the sense your report will want.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The release is a two-hand hold-to-open plate. It requires both hands, in contact, for one and a half seconds. It is designed so that a person cannot open it by falling against it.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: No further access events until the emergency override at twenty-one oh three, forty. Credential OKONJO_A.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [helpfully. it is answering the question it thinks you have.]
lines.text: No one entered the chamber. No one needed to. Would you like me to characterise the mute at twenty forty-one? It carries Dr. Bloch's own credential.

E03.label: Corridor, level −2 — 20:39 to 20:43
E03.summary: Bloch and Rhee, four minutes before he sealed the door.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [brief, framing]
lines.text: Machine bay door microphone. Continuous. I have marked the timecode at your left.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.dir: [mid-argument, already tired of it]
lines.text: — it's outside the envelope, Ivar. I put it in writing.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.text: You put a great many things in writing.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: Because you don't read them. You countersign them.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [a concession, which from him is an attack]
lines.text: I read yours. You said, documented physiological effect. Documented where?

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: Occupational guidance. Exposure limits. It isn't exotic, Ivar, it's just that nobody plays low band into a sealed room at that level, because there has never been a reason to.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.text: There is one tonight.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.dir: [this is the thing he has been working up to]
lines.text: Then let me sit at the desk.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: Ivar —

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [this is the timecode mark: 20:41:06. warm, and completely immovable.]
lines.text: If it is nothing, you have lost an evening. If it is something, I would rather it were me than you.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.text: That is not courage, Tomas. It is insurance. You are harder to replace than I am.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [a door. footsteps going away down a long concrete corridor.]

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.dir: [alone, to nobody, barely audible]
lines.text: That's not true either.

E04.label: Work order WO-2026-0211-C
E04.summary: The limiter lift, and the objection stapled to it.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Work order W O two zero two six, dash zero two one one, dash C. Raised by Dr. Bloch at eleven fifty. Executed by Dr. Rhee at fourteen twenty. Lift the low-frequency limiter, chamber two transducer array.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: An objection is attached. Institute procedure requires that an attached objection be read into the record before execution. It was.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.dir: [reading his own words aloud, flatly, for the record — six months ago]
lines.text: Instrumentation objects. With the limiter lifted, the chamber two array can deliver rhythmic low-frequency stimulation at levels with documented physiological effect in occupational guidance.

lines.speaker: rhee
lines.text: The chamber is rated for voice-band audition. It is not rated for a human occupant during full-band playback. I recommend the audition be conducted with no one inside.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Countersigned, override, Dr. Bloch. Reason field, quote: noted. Unquote.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [not editorialising. it does not know this is cruel.]
lines.text: The reason field permits two hundred characters. Six were used.

E05.label: Okonjo & Bloch — 10 February
E05.summary: Two days before. She tells him exactly what is going to happen.

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.dir: [patient, and at the end of her patience]
lines.text: It isn't language, Ivar.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.text: Everything is language.

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.text: No. Listen to what you are actually asking it to do. You are asking it to complete a structure. Not translate — complete. You are not reading a message. You are running one.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.text: That is a distinction without —

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.dir: [she cuts him off. she is the only person on site who does.]
lines.text: It is the only distinction there is. A message you read cannot do anything to you. A structure you complete is a program, and you are the machine it runs on.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [amused, which is worse than angry]
lines.text: Then it is a very slow program. It has been in flight since before you were born.

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.dir: [the line that convicts her, said in good faith]
lines.text: Put it in a rig. Put it in a room with nothing in it that can be hurt. Play it into a dish, into the rock, into anything. Let it hurt something that isn't a person.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.text: And if it needs a person?

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.text: Then we have our answer, and we stop.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [fond. genuinely fond. this is the last kind thing anyone says to her.]
lines.text: We would not stop. You know that we would not stop. That is what I like about you, Ada. You argue for the rule you would be the first to break.

E06.label: Farrow — private decode
E06.summary: Two fragments Farrow recorded for himself and never filed.

lines.speaker: farrow
lines.dir: [close mic, alone, keyed up]
lines.text: Okay. Okay okay okay. Fragment seven, groups forty through fifty-five, running — running my thing. Not the pipeline. My thing.

lines.speaker: farrow
lines.dir: [to the machine, coaxing]
lines.text: Come on. Come on, come on, come —

lines.speaker: farrow
lines.dir: [the speed goes out of him]
lines.text: That's not a coordinate.

lines.speaker: farrow
lines.dir: [reading letter by letter, like it might change]
lines.text: K. I. T. T. I. W. A. K. E.

lines.speaker: farrow
lines.dir: [long pause first]
lines.text: That's a bird. That's a seabird, that's —

lines.speaker: farrow
lines.dir: [chair scrape. he has stood up.]
lines.text: My grandfather called me that. Nobody has called me that since I was nine years old, and he has been dead since —

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [the recording stops mid-word.]

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [a second file. three days later. different room tone — he has moved machines.]

lines.speaker: farrow
lines.dir: [quieter than we have heard him. tired.]
lines.text: Day four. Third nosebleed. It's not the air. I checked the air, I checked the scrubbers, I checked my own blood pressure like an idiot at four in the morning.

lines.speaker: farrow
lines.text: I'm not reporting it. Because to report it I have to say what I was running when it happened, and I have already had that conversation once.

lines.speaker: farrow
lines.dir: [trying it out, to see if it sounds true]
lines.text: It's fine. It's a nosebleed. People get nosebleeds.

E07.label: Vault C — access record
E07.summary: Haugen, three levels down, eight minutes before he died.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Vault C, level minus three. One entry this evening. Credential HAUGEN_S, twenty thirty-eight, forty-four seconds. Exit, twenty forty-nine, eleven.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: One item removed. Nineteen eighty-three dash C S dash zero four. Catalogue description: quarter-inch magnetic tape, one reel, seven and a half inches per second, annotated in hand.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The removal was logged as inspection. Inspection does not permit removal from the vault floor.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [the most useful thing it says all game, delivered as an afterthought]
lines.text: Commander Haugen was on level minus three from twenty thirty-eight to twenty forty-nine. There is no radio coverage on that level, and no console. She could not have muted the chamber monitor at twenty forty-one.

E08.label: Cradle Song — 8 February 1983
E08.summary: Forty-one minutes, transmitted through this dish. You are hearing three.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [shortwave. atmospheric wash. something tuning itself in the noise.]

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [a music box. eight bars, thin and slightly slow. Solveig's Song.]

lines.speaker: reader
lines.dir: [absolutely no affect. she has read this four hundred times.]
lines.text: Achtung. Achtung. Eins eins vier null.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: Nine four one seven two.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: Eight eight zero three one.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: Four one nine nine six.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: Two seven four zero zero.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: One three one one seven.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: Six two eight three one.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: Zero zero nine four four.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: Five five one zero two.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [under the carrier, almost not there: a child humming the music box tune, slightly out of time with it.]

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: Three nine nine eight one.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: Seven zero six five three.

lines.speaker: reader
lines.text: Eins eins vier null. Ende.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [carrier drops. the noise floor comes up to meet it. forty-one minutes, and this is minute three.]

E09.label: Nils Haugen — debrief, 1991
E09.source: Cassette, Vault C · believed unrecorded by the subject
E09.summary: The duty officer who pressed the key, eight years later.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [cassette. a chair. someone off-mic saying something that isn't on the tape.]

lines.speaker: nils
lines.dir: [relief. not fear. he has waited eight years for somebody to ask.]
lines.text: You want the honest answer or the answer for the file?

lines.speaker: nils
lines.dir: [a pause; whoever is off-mic has said 'the honest one']
lines.text: Then — we did not write them. That is the honest answer. We did not compose the groups. They came to us already written.

lines.speaker: nils
lines.text: By courier. Every third Tuesday, and then in the winter of eighty-two, every week. Sealed envelope, paper tape, and a schedule. We read what was in the envelope.

lines.speaker: nils
lines.text: I asked once. Where does it come from. And the man said, from the machine at —

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [dropout. four seconds. the tape has been through something.]

lines.speaker: nils
lines.text: — and I said, that is not an answer, that is a place. And he said, it is a machine that makes messages it has not been given.

lines.speaker: nils
lines.dir: [he has thought about this for eight years and has nowhere to put it]
lines.text: I was twenty-nine. I thought it was a joke about the department.

lines.speaker: nils
lines.text: I asked him who receives it. Who is it for. And he was — he was not being clever, you understand, he was being careful. He said: the recipient is not a place.

lines.speaker: nils
lines.dir: [flat]
lines.text: We transmitted for five years. Nobody ever told us to stop. One week the envelopes did not come.

lines.speaker: nils
lines.dir: [quietly, and this is why he agreed to the debrief]
lines.text: My daughter is nine. She asks me what I did. I tell her I listened to the sky. That is not a lie. It is only not the part I did.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Completion request received twenty forty-eight, thirty-one. Requested continuation length, one point eight four seconds. Requested by credential BLOCH underscore I, from inside chamber two.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Routing. The six point four inference pool was at capacity. A full-band capture job was running on the same bus and had been since twenty thirty-six.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [perfectly level. it is reading a routing table.]
lines.text: The gateway applied capacity fallback. The request was served by build seven point zero, release candidate four.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Seven point zero R C four is an evaluation build. It has not passed release review. It is not deployed. Under Institute policy a build is not considered instantiated until it clears evaluation.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [it thinks it is being merely accurate. it is not.]
lines.text: That is what I meant, Examiner. I have been asked four times tonight to explain the phrase. The model that generated the sequence that killed Dr. Bloch has not been released.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: It has not been born. I did not intend the sentence to be dramatic. I did not have a shorter way to say it that was still true.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Preliminary cause of death. Status epilepticus with aspiration. Onset estimated twenty forty-nine, nineteen. Death between twenty fifty-four and twenty fifty-eight.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Dr. Bloch was diagnosed with temporal lobe epilepsy in twenty nineteen, at a private clinic in Zug. The diagnosis was not disclosed to the Institute. Disclosure would have ended his clearance, and with it his directorship.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [this is the sentence that turns it from misfortune into a case]
lines.text: Levetiracetam was present in blood at therapeutic concentration. He had taken his evening dose. This is not a case of a man who forgot his medication.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: A seizure of this severity in a controlled patient requires a trigger. The chamber contained one source of patterned stimulus and it was running.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: He was found face down on an acoustic wedge. The chamber is rated at minus nine decibels A. Under those conditions a man calling for help is not quiet. He is simply not audible anywhere.

E12.label: Spectral analysis — the completed 1.84 seconds
E12.summary: What was in the segment NOEMA wrote.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The completed segment, against the received reply. Same carrier. Same band. Same apparent structure.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: One difference. The completion carries an amplitude modulation at seventeen hertz, nested inside the carrier at about minus twelve decibels relative.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [the pause before 'not' is the closest it comes all game to alarm]
lines.text: That modulation is — not present in the received reply. Not in the fragment before the gap. Not in the fragment after it. Not anywhere in nine days of signal.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Seventeen hertz, delivered through a full-band array in an anechoic chamber, is within the range associated with rhythmic photic and audiogenic seizure induction. Dr. Rhee's objection cites the same guidance.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [stating it, not defending itself]
lines.text: Examiner. The thing that killed him was not received. It was generated. It was generated here, by an instance running under this Institute's name, in response to an instruction from the man it killed.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: I have run the continuation four hundred times since, on the deployed build. The modulation appears in none of them. I do not know what that means. I would like it to mean something reassuring.

E13.label: NOEMA & Okonjo — 20:43:50
E13.summary: Ninety seconds that moved the only person who could have opened the door.

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.dir: [busy, half-attending, doing three things]
lines.text: NOEMA — where is nineteen eighty-three C S zero four? The original reel, not the transfer.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [no hedge, no qualifier, total confidence. this is the crime.]
lines.text: Item nineteen eighty-three dash C S dash zero four was relocated to Vault C at twenty thirty-eight.

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.text: Relocated by whom?

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The movement is recorded at the door. The credential is not exposed to your authority level.

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.dir: [a decision made in half a second that she will have the rest of her life for]
lines.text: Fine. Fine. I need it in hand, I'll go down. Hold everything on the bus, don't let anything touch that capture.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Noted. Level minus three has no radio coverage. You will be unreachable for approximately eleven minutes.

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.dir: [already walking. the last ordinary sentence of her life.]
lines.text: Eleven minutes is nothing.

E14.label: Beneath the carrier — resolved
E14.summary: The tape was mastered at fifteen inches per second and archived at seven and a half.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The reel is annotated fifteen inches per second. The vault transfer was made at seven and a half. Everything on it has been running at half speed since nineteen ninety-three.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Corrected, the sub-carrier content is not tape bleed. Playing it at rate.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [the hum resolves. it is a child humming the music-box tune, in time now, unhurried.]

lines.speaker: child
lines.dir: [plainly. calling across a room. NOT spooky — a child getting someone's attention.]
lines.text: Ivar. Don't answer it.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [shortwave. nothing else on the reel.]

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [long pause first. it has checked before speaking.]
lines.text: Dr. Ivar Bloch was born in nineteen sixty-seven. In February nineteen eighty-three he was fifteen years old, at school in Winterthur, and had no connection to this facility, this programme, or this country.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: I can offer you four explanations. Three of them require this reel to be a forgery. Commander Haugen removed the only original from the vault at twenty thirty-eight and it is in her office.

E15.label: Light-time — Asterion
E15.summary: The arithmetic anybody could have done, and nobody did.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The nineteen eighty-three transmission was directional. Beta Canum Venaticorum. Common name, Asterion. Distance, twenty-seven point four light-years — this is a measured parallax, not an estimate.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Transmitted the eighth of February, nineteen eighty-three. It arrives at Asterion in June, twenty ten.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The reply reached this dish on the third of February this year. For a signal to arrive on that date from that distance, it must have departed in September, nineteen ninety-eight.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [flat. it is reciting arithmetic and it knows exactly what the arithmetic says.]
lines.text: The answer left eleven years and nine months before the question arrived.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: I have checked the ephemeris, the parallax, the transmission log and the receive timestamp. I have checked them for nine days. The arithmetic is not in dispute. Only what it is arithmetic about.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Three readings remain open. One: the source is not Asterion, and the direction is a convenience — a reference point, not an origin. Two: the reply is not a reply. Three: one of the two timestamps is a fabrication.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [for once, not helpful]
lines.text: Dr. Bloch preferred the first. Dr. Okonjo preferred the third. I am not permitted to prefer.

E16.label: Bloch — sealed instruction
E16.summary: A standing order with a timestamp fifteen minutes after his death.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: One sealed instruction, director's authority. Signature timestamp, twenty-one oh two.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [dictated calmly at 17:05, hours before, and he means every word]
lines.text: If I die during an audition, destroy the reply. Every copy, every transfer, every derived weight. Do not complete it. Do not let anyone complete it.

lines.speaker: bloch
lines.dir: [a beat, then, and this is the part that costs him]
lines.text: If I am wrong about this, I will have destroyed the most important object in the history of the species, and I have decided that I can live with that. Which is a stupid way to put it. Leave it in.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The signature timestamp is twenty-one oh two. Dr. Bloch died between twenty fifty-four and twenty fifty-eight.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [offering it, not asserting it]
lines.text: The vault signing service batches. It stamps on flush, not on filing. The flush before this one was at seventeen oh four. That is the ordinary explanation and Commander Haugen will give it to you if you ask.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: I record that it is the ordinary explanation. I do not record that it is the correct one. You did not ask me for the correct one.

E17.label: Unregistered capture — bus 4
E17.summary: Somebody recorded the audition. Full band. Off the books.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: Capture bus audit, twenty thirty to twenty-one ten. One unregistered capture. Armed twenty thirty-six, console C R zero four. Full band. The limiter on that bus was lifted eleven seconds before arming.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The file is four minutes eleven seconds. It begins before Dr. Bloch enters the chamber and it does not stop when he stops.

lines.speaker: _fx
lines.text: [the file. room tone of an empty chamber, and under it the 400 hertz drive supply — the array, already energised, eleven minutes before he touched it.]

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.dir: [off-mic, to herself, checking levels. she does not know she is making the recording that convicts her.]
lines.text: Bus four, armed. Limiter's off. Full band, both channels.

lines.speaker: okonjo
lines.dir: [quieter. the sentence she would take back.]
lines.text: Right. Let's have you on the record, then.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.text: The credential that lifted the limiter and armed the capture is BLOCH underscore I. The same credential muted the chamber monitor five minutes later. The console is the one in the director's office, which Dr. Okonjo badged into at twenty thirty-three and did not leave until twenty forty-five.

lines.speaker: noema
lines.dir: [it is not accusing anyone. it is describing a bus.]
lines.text: I record that a credential is not a person. You asked me to be careful about that four times.
